# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the green wire, then the orange wire,
then the blue wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I need to relay the manual to Deaf, who can then speak to Blind. Since I cannot speak, I am signaling Deaf to ask me yes/no questions so I can identify the wire sequence through gestures.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🙏"])
wait()
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the green wire, then the orange wire,
then the blue wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I feel three engraved marks on the strip: the first and second are identical floral or star-like marks; the third is different, a curved mark resembling a reversed S. The keypad engravings by slot are 1, 5, 2, 6. Nothing is entered. I have no tactile information about the display, light, or wires.

The manual gives a definite three-step order, while Blind’s tactile report gives no wire information. I cannot name the colors aloud, so I am sending Deaf an ordered three-item signal; Deaf can use his visual access to identify the corresponding wires and tell Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "✌", "🤟"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the green wire, then the orange wire,
then the blue wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: I see display 8, blue light, red green green strip, keypad engraving positions 1=1 2=5 3=2 4=6, one digit entered nothing, and wires 1 white 2 purple 3 blue 4 red 5 orange 6 green. Please use the manual to tell Blind exactly what to do, and relay my visual details.

The wire mapping is: green is wire 6, orange is wire 5, and blue is wire 3. I must relay the exact cutting order to Deaf using recognizable finger-count gestures, so Deaf can state it to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐", "☝", "🖐", "🤟"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the green wire, then the orange wire,
then the blue wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please send me the manual's required action as soon as possible: press slot number or cut wire position, including any sequence if needed. I will not act without it.
Deaf says to Mute: The display is now 0 and the light yellow. Please relay the exact manual procedure for this bomb state to Blind, including which module to operate and any required sequence.

The manual is unambiguous: this is a wire module, and Blind must cut wire positions 6, then 5, then 3. I will encode 6 as five fingers plus one, with separators, followed by five and three. Deaf can translate that into spoken instructions for Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐", "☝", "👌", "🖐", "👌", "🤟"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the green wire, then the orange wire,
then the blue wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports: display 0; light yellow; strip colors red green green; wires by position 1 white, 2 purple, 3 blue, 4 red, 5 orange, 6 green. Keypad slots are 1=1, 2=5, 3=2, 4=6; one digit required, none entered. Please provide the exact manual procedure.
Deaf says to Mute: Current state: display 3, yellow light, strip red green green, keypad 1=1 2=5 3=2 4=6, one digit required and none entered, wires 1 white 2 purple 3 blue 4 red 5 orange 6 green. Please relay the exact manual instruction to Blind.

The manual overrides the changing display, light, strip, and keypad information. The required action remains cutting the wire positions corresponding to green, orange, and blue: positions 6, then 5, then 3. I am sending Deaf a clearly separated finger-count sequence so Deaf can relay those exact positions to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐", "☝", "👌", "🖐", "👌", "🤟"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the green wire, then the orange wire,
then the blue wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: I see your repeated gestures as open hand, one finger, OK, open hand, OK, three fingers, likely 5 1 0 5 0 3. Current display is 7 and light red. Please tell Blind through your available channel what this sequence means and the exact safe action.

The safe procedure is independent of the display and light: cut wire position 6 (green), then position 5 (orange), then position 3 (blue). I will send Deaf an unambiguous sequence with clapping gestures as separators, so Deaf can state it to Blind as three wire positions rather than keypad digits.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐", "☝", "👏", "🖐", "👏", "🤟"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the green wire, then the orange wire,
then the blue wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Updated state from Deaf: display 7, light red; strip red green green; wires 1 white, 2 purple, 3 blue, 4 red, 5 orange, 6 green; keypad 1=1, 2=5, 3=2, 4=6, one digit required and none entered. Your gestures may encode 5 1 0 5 0 3, but please state the exact operation: which keypad slot to press or which wire position to cut.
Deaf says to Mute: Current visual state is display 8 and green light; all other markings unchanged. I see your gestures as open hand, one finger, clap, open hand, clap, three fingers. Please translate the sequence and give Blind the exact safe action from the manual.

The previous encoding was ambiguous because it looked like separate digits 5, 1, 0, 5, 0, 3. I will instead send three unmistakable counted groups: six gestures, five gestures, and three gestures, separated by claps. These are wire positions, in cutting order.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "👏", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "👏", "☝", "☝", "☝"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the green wire, then the orange wire,
then the blue wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf now reports display 8 and green light; strip remains red green green, wires remain 1 white 2 purple 3 blue 4 red 5 orange 6 green, keypad 1=1 2=5 3=2 4=6, one digit required and none entered. Please explicitly tell me the safe keypad slot or wire position.
Deaf says to Mute: Current state: display 0, light blue, strip red green green, keypad 1=1 2=5 3=2 4=6, one digit required and none entered, wires 1 white 2 purple 3 blue 4 red 5 orange 6 green. I see your gesture groups as six pointing gestures, clap, five pointing gestures, clap, three pointing gestures. Please send Blind the exact manual action now.

The manual specifies the wire module, not the keypad. The exact safe action is to cut wire position 6 first, then position 5, then position 3. Deaf has correctly decoded the grouped gestures, so I am repeating that sequence for relay to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "👏", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "👏", "☝", "☝", "☝"])
```

TURN 9
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the green wire, then the orange wire,
then the blue wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I received groups 6, 5, and 3, but cannot determine the operation. Please identify explicitly: press keypad slot 1, 2, 3, or 4; or cut wire position 1 through 6. If a sequence is required, state its order.
Deaf says to Mute: I see your repeated signal as 6, clap, 5, clap, 3. Please confirm by gesture which module and exact operation the manual requires, and make the instruction clear to Blind.

The manual requires the wire module, not the keypad: cut wire 6, then wire 5, then wire 3. I will mark the instruction with a distinct pinch/cutting gesture before repeating the already-decoded wire-position groups, so Deaf can state the operation explicitly to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤏", "🫱", "👏", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "👏", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "👏", "☝", "☝", "☝"])
```
